Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Contemporary Round Glass Serving Rolling 3-Shelf Bar Cart 32.28"H, Gold
Materials: glass
This beautiful modern serving cart features 3 clear glass shelves housed by a golden iron frame. The smooth curved lines create a bold contemporary statement for this piece and wheeled casters maximize mobility. Golden iron frame and clear glass shelves No assembly required 11.81"L x 15.35"W x 32.28"H Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
